products.name: PawQuest Puzzle Ball
products.short: Turns mealtime into 20 minutes of happy, food-rewarding play.
products.description: A durable, refillable rubber ball that hides kibble or treats inside. As your dog rolls and paws it, food drops out through adjustable openings, keeping them busy, engaged, and slow-eating for longer. Refill, wash, repeat — for years.
features: Twist-open chamber holds 1–2 cups of kibble or treats
3 difficulty settings for beginner to expert dogs
